The fix converts non-Chicago rows to America/Chicago local time before deriving txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'America/Chicago' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE timezone('America/Chicago', timezone(source_tz, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
